INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RNP IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Admission = '+';
SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.APTT >= 45 AND T2.Date > '1997-01-01'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.ID FROM Examination AS T2 JOIN Patient AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T3.ID = T1.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01' AND T1.SC170 IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY Patient.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND T3.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date LIKE '1984%' AND T1.Birthday < DATE('now', '-50 years') AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Description >= '1991-01-01' AND T1.Description < '1992-01-01' AND T2.GLU < 180

SELECT AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS AverageAge
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('-', '+-') ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN T2.ALB < 3.5 OR T2.ALB > 5.5 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) >= 1995 AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT DISTINCT type FROM event WHERE location = 'MU 215'

SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date >= '201201' AND T2.Date <= '201212' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1

FROM customers
INNER JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  AND yearmonth.Consumption < 30000;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(expense.cost) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(event.event_id) AS percentage
FROM 
    expense
INNER JOIN 
    budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
INNER JOIN 
    event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE 
    event.type = 'Game';

FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID

SELECT 
    Segment,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
FROM 
    customers
INNER JOIN 
    yearmonth
ON 
    customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
WHERE 
    Currency = 'EUR' AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY 
    Segment
ORDER BY 
    PercentageIncrease DESC;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM 
    transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    yearmonth AS T2
ON 
    T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T1.Date = '2012-08-25' AND T1.Price = 634.8;
